title: Shanghai: the Skyline, or the Street Food? | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone's first Shanghai photo is the Pudong skyline across the Huangpu River. But Shanghai is China's most populous city — nearly 25 million people — and most of real life happens at street level, in lanes like this one, stall after stall of shengjianbao, skewers and snacks you can't name yet.

This is a POV walk through one of those food lanes: Chinese signage, glowing menus, the crowd moving with you. No towers in frame on purpose — that's the whole question.

★ Expert Tip: come hungry and pay with your phone. Most stalls take Alipay / WeChat Pay QR codes and many no longer want cash, so set up mobile pay before you travel and point-and-scan your way down the lane.

上海是中国人口最多的城市，近 2487 万人。大多数人冲着陆家嘴的天际线来，但真正的烟火气在街头小吃弄堂里：生煎、各种串、叫不出名字的小吃。你会选浦东的天际线，还是选街头这条小吃街？

—
